title: secp256k1-ecdlp: Pollard rho with 6-automorphism, GLV and distinguished points

claims.statement: For uniform x in [0,r) with Q=[x]P on secp256k1, the Pollard rho distinguished-point algorithm with secp256k1 6-automorphism (beta), GLV 2-D decomposition (lambda), 4-way partition and r-adding walk (1024 table) described in proof.md recovers x with probability at least 0.45 using at most 2^125.52 total target-group-operation equivalents (H+R/1000, C=1000), including preprocessing, distinguished table maintenance, all trials and verification. Peak memory is at most 2^38 bytes; preprocessing is at most 2^14.17 group equivalents and is included in total; nonuniform advice is at most 2^0 bytes. This is a classical cold attack summed over 18 ARM cores with no uncharged advice or quantum steps; heuristics are stated with support and limitations.

experiments.purpose: Exhaustively check Pollard rho with negation/automorphism simulation and distinguished points on small additive cyclic groups (orders 101, 1009). Verifies walk correctness, rep canonicalization, distinguished collision resolution and last-block handling at toy scale; does not establish production cost or security.
